commentary: A humanoid robot just ran the 100m in **9.39 seconds** — faster than Usain Bolt has ever run it
caption:
A humanoid robot ran the 100m in 9.39 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.

Usain Bolt’s world record is 9.58, set in Berlin in 2009. Tiangong Ultra, built by the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Centre, went under it. Honor’s Lightning came second at 9.47 — also under Bolt.

Locomotion was the hard problem in robotics for thirty years. That part is now done.
